TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: undying
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: Death doesn't hold it. A few hours after it dies, it rises again, healed, unless its corpse has been destroyed or butchered first. It can only do this once every fifteen days.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: hydra-blooded
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: Cut it down and more grow back. When it dies, two young copies of it spring up beside the corpse, with every other trait it had.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: mirror-scaled
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: Polished, mirror-bright scales cover its body. A third of the shots that hit it glance off in a random direction, where they can strike anyone nearby, and some of those fly straight back at the shooter.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: phasing
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: It slips through space when hurt. Each hit has a chance to make it blink up to 8 tiles away, at most once every 10 seconds.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: pack-caller
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: When something attacks it, it calls out, and others of its kind within 35 tiles come to fight for it.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: dread aura
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: An aura of dread surrounds it. Living enemies within 8 tiles are less aware and move more slowly. Mechanoids and entities don't feel it.

TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.label: elder
TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef.description: An ancient of its kind. It is bigger, tougher and stronger than any other, and its wounds close quickly.
